method: HOST-MEASURED deterministic path traversal, no renderer/cycles. Mean of traversals per path: 4 frame phases x authored mirror states (one or two) x 3 fixed player columns (48/124/200), using the authored entry column. Absolute displacement per tick; terminal retirement tick excluded. Tracking averages depend on player input; segments also expose unclamped cadence rates. HPOS is one colour clock (2 high-resolution pixels); vertical unit is one raster line.
